subject: Local SI bridgework onboarding: data-channeling and residency gaps
messages:
From: Emma Harrison <emma.harrison@lumenhealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: partners@atlassys.com
Date: 2027-05-05T09:12:00+02:00
Subject: Intro / local SI and residency constraints for Lumen POC

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro — LumenHealth is planning a pilot of patient-facing summarization features and we need to validate an EU-local integration path with a systems integrator. Our core data residency asks: 1) no raw PHI leaves EU (pseudonymized payloads allowed), 2) audit logs for inference requests retained in-country for 12 months, 3) support for customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).

Can Redwood share a proposed SI onboarding checklist and any minimum network / enclave requirements so we can validate with our infra and procurement teams? Atlas Systems (cc'd) are the SI we intend to engage and would like to run a joint kickoff next week.

High-level timeline we have in mind: kickoff 5/10, integration sprint (2-3 weeks), procurement + SOW concurrently. Please let me know availability for a 45m kickoff and any pre-reads you need.

Best,
Emma
Emma Harrison
Head of Product Partnerships — LumenHealth
Attachments: none

From: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Harrison <emma.harrison@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com, partners@atlassys.com
Date: 2027-05-05T11:03:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Intro / local SI and residency constraints for Lumen POC

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear scope. Happy to run the kickoff and outline the minimums so the SI and your infra team can validate. I attached a starter SI onboarding checklist that covers: network/firewall rules, allowed payload patterns, KMS patterns, logging/retention, and a proposed canary rollout for the pilot.

Key points up front:
- We support customer-managed keys for private deployments and can provide HSM-integration patterns in the checklist.
- For hosted/Dedicated modes, we can pin processing to EU regions and provide per-request audit metadata; log retention for 12 months is feasible with an enterprise add-on and will be noted in the SOW.
- For strictly on-prem or air-gapped requirements, we should discuss Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem). That path will need the SI to run a small gateway VM and a guaranteed egress policy.

Proposed next steps:
1) Kickoff call (45m) next week — I have Tue 5/10 10:00-11:30 or Wed 5/11 14:00-16:00 CEST.
2) Review attached checklist with your infra and Atlas; mark must-haves vs. nice-to-have.
3) We’ll follow with a short SOW draft (team / timeline / security commitments).

Attaching: Redwood_SI_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (starter)

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SI_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx]

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Harrison <emma.harrison@lumenhealth.com>, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com, partners@atlassys.com
Date: 2027-05-05T13:20:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Intro / local SI and residency constraints for Lumen POC

Emma — welcome. A few practical notes from our side to set expectations:
- Resource commitments: for a 2-3 week integration sprint we typically allocate a Redwood integration engineer (0.25 FTE) + a solutions architect (ad-hoc) for the pilot. If the SI is doing most of the heavy lifting, the FTE profile may be lighter.
- Timeline: if kickoff is 5/10 and the SI has the checklist items validated within 3 business days, we can commonly finish an initial integration by ~5/28 (includes canary + validation).
- Commercials: I'll start a light draft SOW that includes an audit log retention add-on (12m) and optional Private deployment fees if you need on-prem.

I'll block Tue 5/10 10:00 CEST for the kickoff; if that works for you we can send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, Emma Harrison <emma.harrison@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: partners@atlassys.com
Date: 2027-05-06T09:45:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Intro / local SI and residency constraints for Lumen POC

Emma / team — quick technical clarifications ahead of kickoff:
- Payload handling: recommend pseudonymization at the client side (Lumen) before transit. For highest assurance, the SI can run a small ingress proxy in EU that strips direct identifiers and forwards tokens to Redwood.
- KV cache: to avoid persistence of PHI we can scope KV cache lifetime to the request session and disable long-term traces for fields flagged "PHI". That will affect cache hit rates; we'll document trade-offs in the checklist.
- Network: we'll need the SI to open outbound TLS to specific EU-hosted endpoints and to allow inbound SSH from our maintenance IPs for a limited window. See attached diagram for the recommended topology.

Attaching: network_integration_diagram.png

Irene / Marissa — I flagged a couple of items in the checklist where we should offer an optional manual validation run for Lumen's security team (helps procurement sign-off).

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: network_integration_diagram.png]

From: Emma Harrison <emma.harrison@lumenhealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: partners@atlassys.com
Date: 2027-05-07T16:45:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Intro / local SI and residency constraints for Lumen POC

Thanks all — Tue 5/10 10:00 CEST works for us. I've looped in procurement (separately) and they asked for a short SOW draft and a statement on encryption-at-rest practices.

Next steps for the kickoff:
- Redwood to share checklist (received) and a one-page SOW skeleton before the call (Marissa noted she will draft).
- Atlas to confirm their runbook and resource allocation prior to the call.
- Procurement requested a one-paragraph note on KMS/HSM support and an expected cost range for the 12-month audit-log retention add-on (even a placeholder is fine to unblock).

I'll circulate a calendar invite for 5/10 10:00 CEST and include the Atlas PM.

Speak soon,
Emma
Head of Product Partnerships — LumenHealth
[Attachment: Lumen_SOW-draft.pdf]
